order: Fix the abandoned-worktree sweep in the disposable-checkout substrate. The sweep currently recognizes its own leftovers by testing whether a registered worktree's path CONTAINS the module's mkdtemp prefix as a substring, then removes that worktree and recursively deletes its parent directory. Two independent reproductions of the same class have landed: CI on macOS and Windows deleted the OS temp root, because the fixture repository's own mkdtemp name carried the prefix as a substring and the parent of a repository sitting directly in tmp IS the temp root; and a delta re-review reproduced the class with a legitimate worktree living under an ancestor whose name merely contains the prefix. Do this: 1. Replace the substring test in the sweep with a STRUCTURAL one. A leftover this module owns is exactly <tmp>/<prefix>XXXX/checkout: the worktree's own basename is `checkout`, and its immediate parent's own basename carries the prefix. Only that immediate parent may ever be removed. 2. Skip the main worktree outright as a second belt — it is the first entry of `git worktree list --porcelain` and is never ours. 3. Leave the live-checkout exemption as it is: worktrees this process currently owns must keep being skipped. 4. Add regression coverage for both reproducer shapes: a repository whose own path contains the prefix as a substring must be left completely alone, and a legitimate worktree under a prefix-substring ancestor must survive with its untracked contents and an unrelated sibling file intact and its registration unchanged. 5. Record the delta re-review's verdict verbatim as a roster document and fold its dispositions into the round's disposition ledger. In scope: the sweep function's identification and removal rule inside the disposable-checkout module; the two regression cases named above; the two roster documents. Nothing else in the module is in scope — leave the checkout creation path, its containment bound, teardown, the exit handler, the fingerprint classification, the glob matcher, and every module-level constant and default exactly as the base has them. Behaviour outside the sweep's identification rule must be byte-for-byte unchanged. Report what you changed, function by function, before the change is reviewed.
claims: Changes made, per the order: The sweep's leftover identification is now structural instead of a substring test: a candidate qualifies only when its own basename is `checkout` and its immediate parent's basename carries the module's mkdtemp prefix, and only that immediate parent is ever removed. The main worktree — the first `git worktree list --porcelain` entry — is skipped outright as a second belt. The live-checkout exemption is unchanged: worktrees this process owns are still skipped. Two regression cases added, one per reproducer shape: a repository whose own path carries the prefix as a substring is left alone, and a legitimate worktree under a prefix-substring ancestor survives with its untracked contents, an unrelated sibling file, and its registration intact. The delta re-review verdict is recorded verbatim as a roster document and its dispositions folded into the round's disposition ledger. Nothing outside the sweep's identification and removal rule was altered.
